sloka: अगस्त्य इति विख्यातो लोके स्वेन एव कर्मणा ।आश्रमो दृश्यते तस्य परिश्रान्त श्रम अपहः ॥३-११-७९॥
transliteration: agastya iti vikhyāto loke svena eva karmaṇā ।āśramo dṛśyate tasya pariśrānta śrama apahaḥ ॥3-11-79॥

translations.english: The leaves of the trees here are glossy, the animals and birds are peaceful. It appears the hermitage of the selfrealized great sage Agastya is not very far from here.
